Introduction
Discover everything you need to know about buying tickets, streaming live and on-demand shows, and enjoying unforgettable experiences with CloudJoi – your ultimate ticketing, streaming, and community platform in Malaysia!

Category: Ticketing Process
Question: Is there a time limit when purchasing tickets online?
Answer: All seats are reserved for 15 minutes. If the booking is not finalized within this time frame, the seats will be released for the next potential buyer.

Category: Ticketing Process
Question: Why am I encountering a credit card error at checkout?
Answer: If you've reached the purchase page, entered your card number, and submitted your order, but received a credit card error message, we suggest double-checking your card details and available funds, then attempting the transaction again.

Category: Ticketing Process
Question: Why is there a ticket limit when purchasing?
Answer: For general events, we allow a maximum of 12 tickets per order. However, ticket limits are determined by the event organizers as part of our measures to ensure fairness and provide everyone with an equal opportunity to obtain tickets.

Category: Ticketing Process
Question: Why am I seeing 'Fully Queued'? Are the tickets still available?
Answer: When you see 'Fully Queued' on the page, it means that the last batch of tickets has been reserved for a purchaser to complete their payment. However, this reservation may expire if the current patron does not complete the purchase within the 15-minute grace period. You can try again in 15 minutes to see if the tickets have been released.

Category: Payment Methods
Question: What payment methods does CloudJoi offer?
Answer: We provide a range of payment options, including mobile e-wallets (such as Touch 'n Go, ShopeePay Malaysia, and GrabPay Malaysia), Malaysia Online Banking as well as Malaysia and International Credit Cards.

Category: Ticket Retrieval and Assistance
Question: I purchased a ticket but didn't receive a confirmation email. What should I do?
Answer: Please check your email inbox, junk, and promotions folders. If you can't find it, please contact us for assistance.

Category: Ticket Retrieval and Assistance
Question: I accidentally deleted the email, how do I retrieve the tickets?
Answer: If you have a CloudJoi ID, simply log in using the same email address. You'll find your tickets under "My Tickets." Please note that if you're a new signup, it may take a moment to consolidate all your previous purchases into your CloudJoi ID.

Category: Ticket Retrieval and Assistance
Question: I tried to login with mobile apps, but I couldn't find my tickets in my purchase history, what should I do?
Answer: If you've tried logging in through the mobile apps but couldn't find your tickets in your purchase history, follow these steps: Make sure that your previous order has the same email address associated with your CloudJoi ID. Alternatively, feel free to contact us directly for assistance.

Category: Ticket Retrieval and Assistance
Question: Where do I download the mobile apps?
Answer: Our mobile app available for Apple AppStore, Android PlayStore and Huawei App Gallery. Just search "CloudJoi" on the respective App.

Category: Ticket Retrieval and Assistance
Question: Do I need to print out the e-tickets?
Answer: You do not need to print any e-ticket for admission purpose. You may present the e-tickets upon admission to the front of house.

Category: Refunds, Exchanges, and Rebates
Question: What is CloudJoi's refund and exchange policy?
Answer: According to our ticketing terms, no refunds, exchanges, or cancellations are permitted once a booking is made, unless the event is canceled or postponed. To ensure clarity, our system confirms your purchase multiple times before payment. We highly recommend carefully reviewing your booking details before finalizing payment.

Category: Refunds, Exchanges, and Rebates
Question: I forgot to apply the promo code after completing the purchase. Can I still request a rebate?
Answer: Unfortunately, we cannot accommodate requests for retroactive application of promo codes, rebates, or discounts after the checkout process is complete. We advise double-checking if the promo code has been applied before proceeding to payment.

Category: Refunds, Exchanges, and Rebates
Question: I cannot attend the event. Can I receive a refund?
Answer: Unfortunately, once the transaction is confirmed, no refunds or exchanges are permitted unless the event is canceled or postponed. However, depending on the event organizer, some events may allow you to transfer the ticket to friends or family.

Category: Watching Online
Question: Where can I watch the show?
Answer: You can watch it on your computer, laptop, tablet or mobile phone. Just make sure you have a stable internet connection.

Category: Watching Online
Question: Can I be late?
Answer: Yes, but try to be on time. It is like going to the cinema — if you are late, you will not be able to watch it from the beginning.

Category: Watching Online
Question: How do I watch it in full screen mode?
Answer: Move your cursor to the bottom right corner of the video, and click the expand button to make the video full screen.

Category: Watching Online
Question: How fast do I need my internet to experience CloudTheatre?
Answer: To stream videos in HD, at least 10 Mbps is recommended. Visit [Fast.com] (https://fast.com/) to check your current internet speed.

Category: Watching Online
Question: My chat box kept loading without any content.
Answer: Kindly clear cache and reload your browser. If the problem persists, please contact us via for help.

Category: Watching Online
Question: Can I share my Passcode to my friend?
Answer: Each Passcode can only be used on one unique device. You are required to purchase additional ticket for each device you want to connect to.

Category: Watching Online
Question: Can I still visit the show afterward?
Answer: No, the door will close in 60 minutes after the show. You are encouraged to stay on after the show to chat and mingle with the organiser.

Category: Watch On-Demand
Question: Do I need to watch the show immediately after purchasing the ticket?
Answer: You don't have to watch it right away. However, it's recommended to watch it on-demand, subject to availability on our platform.

Category: Watch On-Demand
Question: How do the 24/48 hours work?
Answer: Once you enter the CloudTheatre, you have either 24 or 48 hours to complete watching the show. After this time period, your tickets will be deemed invalid, and you won't be allowed to reenter the space.

Ticket purchaser are advised to ensure the accurate application of such

The Organiser may offer discounted tickets after tickets go on sale and will

Exchange of Tickets
No refund or exchange of tickets will be made under any circumstances unless
the Event is postponed or cancelled. In the event of postponement or

While we make efforts to send reminder emails before the event, the ticket

Admission
Only valid ticket holders will be granted admission to the event.
Proof of identity may be required to shown to obtain discounts and upon
admission such as student identification, MyKad or Passport for senior
citizens.
Venue Owner or Event Organiser reserves the right without refund or
compensation to refuse admission to any persons whose conduct is
disorderly or unbecoming.
Infants in arms or children without tickets will not be admitted for safety
reasons.
Latecomers can only be admitted at a suitable break during the performance
at the discretion of the Venue Owner. However, admission cannot be
guaranteed and no refund request would be entertained.
The Ticket Holder agrees to submit to any search for any prohibited items
including but not limited to weapons, controlled, dangerous and illegal
substances and recording devices.

Streaming
Sharing of Passcode is strictly prohibited. A single Passcode can only be
used to stream on one device only.
It is at the Ticket Purchaser's responsibility to ensure a stable Internet
connection for smooth streaming.
Strictly no audio recording or screen recording is allowed during the Event.

Personal Information
Personal information is collected from all Ticket Purchasers in order to
facilitate ticket purchase or other services available.
This information is collected and used in accordance with our Terms of
Use and Privacy Policy, which form part of these terms & conditions.
By providing any personal information to CloudJoi, you agree that CloudJoi
shall be entitled to use and process such data.

Data Collection and Usage
No Sale of Data: We do not sell or rent your personal data to any third parties
under any circumstances.
Purpose of Data Usage:
We collect and process your personal data solely for the purposes of
analyzing, accounting, reporting, and auditing our operations, ensuring
legal compliance, and improving our services.
We may use your data internally for marketing, promotional, and service-
related communication within CloudJoi.
Sharing with Event Organizers: Your personal data will be shared with the
event organizer for the specific event you have purchased a ticket for. This
enables them to manage the event, including ticket validation, attendee
communication, and event updates. However, the organizer must handle your
data in compliance with applicable data protection laws.
Data Security and Protection: We implement appropriate technical and
organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized
access, misuse, loss, or disclosure.
Legal Obligations: We may also share your data when required by law,
regulation, or legal process, such as responding to a court order or
government request.

Refunds
If an Event is postponed or cancelled, the Event Organiser shall at its own
discretion place notices advising procedures for Refund Request and Refund
Request Period within which the Ticket Purchasers may request for refund.
No refunds will be made if the Refund Request is made after the Refund
Request Period. Such unrefunded sums shall be dealt with at CloudJoi or the
Event Organiser's sole discretion.
Ticket Purchasers are required to provide refund information like contact
information, proof of purchase, and banking details for the refund to be
processed.
All refund requests should be directed to the event organiser. CloudJoi,
acting as the event organiser's agent, may process refunds, subject to the
event organiser authorization and the availability of sums held by CloudJoi
for the event organiser.
CloudJoi will not process refunds if the event organiser hasn't authorized us,
prepaid sums, or if CloudJoi no longer holds event organiser's proceeds.
The Ticket Handling Fee is strictly non-refundable under any circumstances,
including but not limited to event postponement, cancellation, or any other
reasons leading to a refund request.
The Event Organizer reserves the right to transfer any applicable service fees
and refund processing fees to the audience.
For the avoidance of doubt, complimentary tickets shall not be eligible for
refunds.

Prohibited Conduct

Those prohibited conduct includes, but is not limited to:
Bringing illegal drugs or weapons to the event.
Engaging in disorderly or disruptive behavior.
Failing to comply with the event's rules and regulations.
Violating the terms and conditions of these tickets.
CloudJoi, event organiser, venue owner reserves the right to remove any person

Queries, Compliants and Dispute

provided at the time of purchase if it wasn't online. It's your responsibility to
update us on any contact detail changes, especially your email address, which is
our preferred method of communication. Check your junk/spam folders for our
emails.
For queries or complaints about your purchase, please contact us here,
mentioning any Order ID, Email Address and name of the event.
We will acknowledge your query or complaint promptly, and in any case,
within five business days of receiving it.
Before responding to your query or complaint, we may need to contact one
or more Event Organiser for additional information.
In case of a dispute, we will make reasonable efforts to consult or negotiate
in good faith for a just and equitable settlement that satisfies you, us, and any
relevant Event Organiser. Please be aware that certain complaints may take
up to 30 working days to resolve.
For the avoidance of doubt, any complaints regarding the Event and/or
regarding the Venue shall be directed solely to and dealt with by the
respective Event Partners.

representatives.

What is CloudJoi’s refund and exchange policy?
Last updated on May 4, 2025
All ticket sales are final. We do not allow refunds, exchanges, or cancellations once
a booking is confirmed—unless the event is officially canceled or postponed.
To avoid any mix-ups, our system provides several confirmation steps before you
complete your purchase. We strongly recommend double-checking your event,
date, time, and ticket details before making payment.
